technical.summary: Short-term momentum is overbought with bullish technicals, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, creating conflicting signals and limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: WDC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 35 days.

sentiment.summary: No composite congressional signal; isolated junior member purchases 142+ days old lack conviction; market fear (42 score) presents contrarian opportunity but insufficient supporting evidence.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (403.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 35 days adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 overbought with Donchian 10 new high and supertrend bullish creates short-term momentum setup, and fear-zone market sentiment offers contrarian opportunity for tactical entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (EMA 50, SMA 50, SMA 200) and Ichimoku cloud with negative AO, zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis conditions, and earnings binary risk in 35 days make this a high-risk, low-conviction swing entry.
